text:
Alex: seeing odd behavior — sending X-Customer-Priority: high to the gateway but requests still hit the default route. attaching minimal config we use below. anyone seen this?

Alex: ```yaml
routes:
  - match:
      path_prefix: /api/v1/ingest
      headers:
        - name: X-Customer-Priority
          exact_match: high
    route: high-priority-pool
  - match:
      path_prefix: /api/v1/ingest
    route: default-pool
```

Maya: quick q — is the header arriving at envoy/front proxy or getting stripped upstream? can you curl with -v and paste the request/response headers?

Alex: curl -v shows the header present when it hits the gateway, e.g.

Alex: ```
> X-Customer-Priority: high
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

Raj: two things that bite here: header normalization (dash vs underscore) and our security strip list. we strip `X-Internal-*` by default. also Envoy header matching can be case-sensitive depending on config.

Sam: also verify match type — `exact_match` on header requires the header to be single-valued and exact. if the client sends `high; q=1` or multiple values, it won't match.

Maya: can you grep the access logs for the raw header? `grep X-Customer-Priority /var/log/envoy/access.log` should show if it was present on the inbound request.

Alex: logs show it present: `X-Customer-Priority=high` but still default route used. so header reached envoy, but route selection skipped it.

Raj: hmm, if header is present but not matching, check if route matching precedence is wrong. our current config evaluates path_prefix then header conditions only if `typed_matchers` enabled. maybe staged change removed that flag.

Anya: security note: allowing arbitrary customer headers to steer routing is risky — we should gate this behind a tenant allowlist and an audit event. otherwise customers can spoof high-priority to get cheaper latency.

Sam: agree. proposal: add `header_override_policy` with fields: `enabled`, `allowed_tenants`, `audit: true`. default false.

Anya: +1. also add telemetry: emit `routing.override.request` with tenant id, header keys, matched route. keep sample rate 1.

Maya: small UX ask — console should display which rule matched for a request (path/header/ua) so support can triage quickly. flagging Product.

InfraBot: PR #4283 created: envoy: respect header match order + add `header_override_policy`. CI green, deploying to staging in 10m — https://git.internal/pr/4283

Alex: will test staging once it lands. thanks for quick triage.

Sam: if staging looks good we'll roll to canary with `feature:header_override_routing` off by default, enable for staging orgs.

Anya: I'll write the audit event schema and add it to security docs.

Maya: reassigning to @raj to follow-up if needed and to update the YAML generator so UI toggles map to `header_override_policy`.

Raj: on it. I'll also add extra unit tests for multi-value header handling and case normalization.

Alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup: will report back after staging run.
